name: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) Seller Registration
authority: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) / Ministry of Commerce and Industry
description: Online registration portal for sellers and service providers to register on the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) platform to supply goods and services to central and state government departments, PSUs, and autonomous bodies. GeM is a mandatory procurement platform for government purchases above certain thresholds, ensuring transparent pricing, competitive bidding, and a direct order system. Sellers can register under goods, services, or works categories.

verifiedConditions.description: Seller must have a valid GST registration to register on GeM portal
Seller must have a valid PAN (Permanent Account Number)
Seller must have an active bank account linked for payment processing
Business must be a recognized entity type eligible for GeM registration

conditions.name: Seller Category Selection
conditions.description: Seller must select the category under which they wish to register — goods, services, or works

conditions.name: MSE Status Check
conditions.description: If the seller is a Micro/Small Enterprise, additional benefits under procurement policy apply

conditions.name: Startup Recognition
conditions.description: DPIIT-recognized startups get relaxation in prior experience and turnover criteria

requirements.name: GST Registration Certificate
requirements.description: Valid GST registration certificate issued by GSTN. GSTIN is mandatory for seller registration on GeM.

requirements.name: PAN Card
requirements.description: Permanent Account Number (PAN) card of the business entity or proprietor.

requirements.name: Bank Account Details
requirements.description: Active bank account details including account number, IFSC code, and cancelled cheque for payment processing.

requirements.name: Business Registration Documents
requirements.description: Relevant business registration documents such as Certificate of Incorporation, Partnership Deed, or Udyam Registration as applicable.

requirements.name: Authorized Signatory Details
requirements.description: Aadhaar number and details of the authorized signatory who will operate the GeM seller account.

requirements.name: Product/Service Catalogue
requirements.description: Details of goods or services to be listed on GeM including specifications, pricing, and relevant certifications.

processInformation.name: Visit GeM Portal
processInformation.description: Navigate to gem.gov.in and click on 'Sign Up' to begin the seller registration process.

processInformation.name: Select Registration Type
processInformation.description: Choose 'Seller' registration and select the appropriate category — goods, services, or works.

processInformation.name: Aadhaar Verification
processInformation.description: Enter Aadhaar number of the authorized signatory and complete OTP-based verification.

processInformation.name: PAN Verification
processInformation.description: Enter PAN details for automatic verification against the Income Tax database.

processInformation.name: GST Verification
processInformation.description: Enter GSTIN for automatic verification against the GST Network (GSTN) database.

processInformation.name: Fill Business Details
processInformation.description: Provide complete business details including entity type, address, contact information, and bank account details.

processInformation.name: Upload Documents
processInformation.description: Upload required supporting documents including business registration certificates and cancelled cheque.

processInformation.name: Product/Service Listing
processInformation.description: Add products or services to the catalogue with specifications, pricing, and relevant quality certifications.

processInformation.name: Review and Submit
processInformation.description: Review all entered information and submit the registration application for processing.

processInformation.name: Registration Approval
processInformation.description: Upon successful verification of all documents and details, the seller account is activated on GeM portal.

output.name: GeM Seller Registration Certificate
output.description: Active seller account on the Government e-Marketplace with a unique Seller ID enabling participation in government procurement through bids, reverse auctions, and direct purchase orders.
output.validityPeriod: As long as the seller maintains valid GST registration and complies with GeM terms

fees.description: Registration on GeM portal is free of charge. No registration fee is levied on sellers.

processingTime.description: Registration is typically completed within 1 to 7 working days after successful document verification. Real-time verification of Aadhaar, PAN, and GST may enable faster processing.

limitations: Registration requires valid GST registration; businesses without GST cannot register directly on GeM.
Sellers must maintain active GST compliance to continue listing on GeM.
Product and service listings must conform to GeM catalogue specifications and quality standards.
Sellers found in violation of GeM terms may be suspended or debarred from the platform.
Certain product categories may require additional quality certifications or BIS standards compliance.
GeM registration does not guarantee procurement orders — orders depend on government buyer requirements.

review.notes: Service information compiled from the official GeM portal. Eligibility conditions and process steps need periodic review as GeM regularly updates its registration procedures and requirements. Fee structure and processing times should be verified against the latest portal updates.
